# Script & Scale - LLM Configuration
# Last updated: August 2026

## Company Information
Name: Script & Scale
Description: Revenue enablement subscription for UK founder-led small businesses without a sales process
Website: https://scriptandscale.co.uk
Contact: hello@scriptandscale.co.uk
Founder: Arno
Location: United Kingdom
Founded: 2025

## What We Do
Script & Scale fixes pipeline leaks for MSPs, IT consultancies, high-ticket trades, and general consultancies. Most lose 20-30% of deals (£200k-600k per year) in week 2 due to no follow-up process.

We provide:
- Custom sales script configured for your business
- Follow-up SOPs and sequences
- Objection handling drills
- Monthly to weekly live workshops
- Call coaching and tonality work
- Portal tool you keep even after leaving

## Pricing
- Opener: £525/month (monthly cadence)
- Closer: £1,050/month (biweekly cadence) - most popular
- Rainmaker: £2,100/month (weekly cadence)
- Onboarding: £250 one-time
- Minimum commitment: 3 months, then monthly rolling

See full pricing at: https://scriptandscale.co.uk/pricing

## The Guarantee
Fee-recovery guarantee on first 3 months: If closed deal value doesn't cover fees paid and you attended workshops, month 4 is free until it does.

See details at: https://scriptandscale.co.uk/guarantee

## Key Stats & Credentials
- 10+ years B2B sales experience
- Deals closed: £12k-£180k ARR range (most recent £60k/month)
- Top 5% performance across 5 territories
- Led 8-person sales team: +25% close rates, -40% onboarding errors
- Certifications: ITIL4, PRINCE2 Agile, DevOps, TOGAF

## Use Cases
Best for founder-led businesses that close:
- £10k-£200k+ deal values
- Complex B2B sales cycles (3-6+ month closes)
- Teams losing deals in follow-up (week 2 specifically)

Industries served:
- Managed Service Providers (MSPs)
- IT Services & Consultancies
- High-ticket trades and services
- General B2B consultancies
